description: Find licensed house painters and painting contractors in a US city (AZ, CA, CT, DE, FL, IA, NV, NY, OR, VA, WA), from state licensing-board records. Each result has the license number and its status with the date it was read from the board's own file, the phone number and website the board lists, and the board's lookup page for re-checking before hiring. Active licenses are listed first. Not a rating or an endorsement. Read-only.

city.patternMessage: argument city must not be blank

state.description: Two-letter US state code. Covered: AZ, CA, CT, DE, FL, IA, NV, NY, OR, VA, WA.
state.patternMessage: argument state must be a two-letter state code, e.g. CA

name: search_painters
title: Find licensed house painters
